scope: CNN/PPO and transformer/PPO rollout, optimization, observations, native rules, resume and evaluation code. Training continues.
verified_semantics: Rollouts finish games; +/-1 outcome assigned separately to every acting player, draws zero. No cross-player sign error.
Exact card+square categorical policy masks illegal/padded actions in rollout and update; padding does not reorder chosen action indices.
Fresh frozen-policy rollouts; old log probabilities detached; no replay. Clipped PPO ratio uses correct sign for positive and negative advantages.
Actor uses eval mode; training freezes BatchNorm stats; transformer dropout=0, avoiding dropout-induced old/new policy mismatch.
Balanced learner seats with 50% current selfplay,25% frozenGRU,25% historical; frozen opponents are not trained.
Native full games and observations covered against Python including Jack removal, completed sequences, dead-card skipping and hidden-information invariance.
Checkpoint restored Adam slots, counters, Python/NumPy/CPU RNG and mapped activeCUDA RNG. Original checkpoint retained. No schedule/optimizer reset.
Loss and gradient nonfinite checks stop invalid updates; live entropy,KL,value error finite; both continuations advancing.
Independent final paired seeds disjoint from training/development; promotion uses incumbent and heldout gates, not monitor winner selection.
